page_title: WOL 1-2 DOR | Wolfsburg v Dortmund 07/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+5' Luca Reggiani (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Maximilian Beier.
90+4' Jeanuel Belocian (Wolfsburg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Timo Gerach blows his whistle for an infringement.
90+4' Jan Burger (Wolfsburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+1' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

90+1' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) receives a pass and fires in a shot from the edge of the box. It deflects off one of the defending players and hits the underside of the crossbar! The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg win a corner kick.
90+1' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) brings an opponent down and Timo Gerach interrupts the game.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Substitution. Niklas Sule makes way for Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund).
88' Here is a change. Felix Nmecha is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Salih Ozcan (Dortmund).
88' Julian Brandt goes off the pitch and Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) comes on.
87' 1 - 2 Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
86' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
84' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' Daniel Bauer decides to make a substitution. Adam Daghim will be replaced by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Mohamed Amoura can be given a rest.
83' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) trips an opposition player and Timo Gerach signals a foul. Free kick. Wolfsburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
80' What a chance that is! Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
79' A dangerous looking corner kick from Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is cleared to safety by the defence.
76' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Timo Gerach interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
73' Jan Burger (Wolfsburg) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
71' Gregor Kobel pulls off a great save to deny Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
69' It is time for a substitution. Fabio Silva (Dortmund) is on for Julian Ryerson.
67' That was close by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
66' A precise low pass is received by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
64' Daniel Bauer has decided to make a change. Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) replaces Kento Shiogai.
64' Here comes a substitution. Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Kevin Paredes.
63' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
60' The resulting corner from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
57' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
56' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Timo Gerach signals.
56' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

52' 1 - 1 Goal! Maximilian Arnold flighted in the free kick and the ball found the head of Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg), whose bullet header from near the penalty spot went straight into the middle of the goal. The score is 1:1.
51' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
51' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) for a tough tackle.
49' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
47' Today's referee Timo Gerach rightly decides to book Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) for his harsh tackle.
47' Gregor Kobel comes off his line to intercept the corner from Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg).

46' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Corner kick. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

45+2' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara is equal to it and makes an easy save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Dortmund.
45+1' A short pass finds Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
43' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
43' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) prepares to take a corner kick.

42' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) rose high to meet a perfectly taken corner kick and attempted to steer a fine header from inside the box towards the left side of the goal. Nobody knows what would have happened if one of the defending players hadn’t pulled off a brilliant intervention to block the effort. Dortmund get a corner.
42' Corner kick. Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is ready to send the ball into the box.

41' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. It will be a corner kick for Dortmund.
38' 0 - 1 Julian Brandt (Dortmund) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
38' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is about to take a corner kick.

38' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
35' Timo Gerach couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) and blew his whistle.
34' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
33' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Dortmund force their opponents to concede a corner.

32' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) picks up a good pass deep inside the box and after a nice touch unleashes a low shot towards the middle of the goal. It's a sublime effort, but one of the defenders deflects the ball and it rattles the post. Great defensive play! The linesman points to the corner flag, Dortmund are going to take it.
30' What a big chance! Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
27' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
25' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
25' The linesman signals that Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
24' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the left post.
23' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
21' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
20' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Daniel Bauer is forced to make a change. Kilian Fischer is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jan Burger (Wolfsburg).
16' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
15' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
14' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Kamil Grabara.
12' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes it short.

12' This shall not pass! Jeanuel Belocian (Wolfsburg) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) heads on.
7' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
7' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Dortmund have a corner.
5' Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
4' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
3' It looks like Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) saw red with that tackle. Timo Gerach won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Wolfsburg will kick the game off.
Timo Gerach will officiate today.
